answer: Reaching eligibility takes 87 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone forfeits for every seat it wants. The kernel register is checked at draw time, hollow lists the eligible set, and zenith seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 87 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 30 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
